mapper.sql: COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('attachmentId',ordered.attachment_id, 'displayName',ordered.display_name,'sizeBytes',ordered.size_bytes, 'mediaKind',ordered.media_kind,'mediaType',ordered.media_type)) FROM (SELECT json_extract(block.value,'$.attachmentId') AS attachment_id, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN '附件不可用' ELSE a.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.size_bytes END AS size_bytes, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN 'binary' ELSE lower(a.media_kind) END AS media_kind, CASE WHEN a.attachment_id IS NULL THEN 'application/octet-stream' ELSE a.media_type END AS media_type FROM json_each(ja_turn_input.content_json) block LEFT JOIN ja_turn_input_attachment pia ON pia.input_id=ja_turn_input.input_id AND pia.attachment_id=json_extract(block.value,'$.attachmentId') LEFT JOIN ja_attachment a ON a.attachment_id=pia.attachment_id WHERE json_extract(block.value,'$.kind')='attachment' ORDER BY CAST(block.key AS INTEGER)) ordered),json_array())
mapper.select: SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at_ms,x.updated_at_ms, x.completed_at_ms,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at_ms,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, x.input_queue_revision,x.is_accepting_inputs, NULL AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json,x.is_current_path,x.source_message_id, (SELECT tm.item_id FROM ja_conversation_timeline_entry tm JOIN ja_conversation_message m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id WHERE tm.turn_id=x.turn_id AND tm.thread_id=x.thread_id AND tm.kind='FINAL_ANSWER' ORDER BY m.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) AS terminal_message_id FROM ja_conversation_turn x LEFT JOIN ja_turn_change_set c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY x.turn_sequence
SELECT turn_id FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND is_current_path=1 ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT x.turn_id,x.thread_id,x.state,x.mutation_version,x.requested_at_ms,x.updated_at_ms, x.completed_at_ms,x.terminal_summary,x.error_code,x.error_message,x.cancel_requested_at_ms,x.cancel_reason, x.cancel_thread_revision,x.cancel_turn_mutation_version, x.input_queue_revision,x.is_accepting_inputs, t.revision AS thread_revision,c.change_set_json,x.is_current_path,x.source_message_id, (SELECT tm.item_id FROM ja_conversation_timeline_entry tm JOIN ja_conversation_message m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id WHERE tm.turn_id=x.turn_id AND tm.thread_id=x.thread_id AND tm.kind='FINAL_ANSWER' ORDER BY m.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) AS terminal_message_id FROM ja_conversation_turn x JOIN ja_conversation_thread t ON t.thread_id=x.thread_id LEFT JOIN ja_turn_change_set c ON c.turn_id=x.turn_id WHERE x.turn_id=#{turnId} AND t.deleted_at_ms IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id<>#{turnId} LIMIT 1)

SELECT m.message_id,m.role,r.record_id,r.record_type,r.payload_schema_version,r.record_sequence,r.payload_json,r.occurred_at_ms FROM ja_conversation_message m JOIN ja_conversation_timeline_entry t ON t.item_id=m.message_id AND t.thread_id=m.thread_id AND t.turn_id=m.turn_id JOIN agent_record r ON r.tenant_id=m.core_tenant_id AND r.thread_id=m.core_thread_id AND r.turn_id=m.core_turn_id AND r.record_id=m.core_record_id AND r.user_id=#{ownerUserId} WHERE m.thread_id=#{threadId} AND m.turn_id=#{turnId} AND m.role='USER' AND t.kind='USER_INPUT' ORDER BY m.ordinal LIMIT 1
SELECT artifact_id,content,character_length FROM ja_tool_artifact WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND artifact_id=#{artifactId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_turn_usage WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT input_id,thread_id,turn_id,kind,content_json,validation_status,issue_error_code, issue_message,is_issue_retryable,input_revision,created_at_ms,
AS attachments_json FROM ja_turn_input WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='PENDING' ORDER BY CASE kind WHEN 'STEERING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN kind='STEERING' THEN priority_sequence ELSE input_sequence END
